per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to parts searches within 15 seconds to prevent user frustration and maintain focus.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to repair facility searches within 10 seconds to ensure quick access to information while at a location.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should handle a large number of concurrent users, specifically in the low thousands of simultaneous sessions, without performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be able to handle up to 1500 simultaneous users. The system shall perform with 1500 users as a time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be highly available, with downtime limited to ensure business continuity, aiming for high nineties percentage availability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should implement standard security protections, such as rate-limiting and CDN or WAF patterns, to mitigate denial-of-service attacks and ensure basic protections against other simple attacks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have role-based access control to ensure that not everyone can see or modify all data, preventing unauthorized access to administrative or personal data.
The system should be designed to be easy to use, with minimal training required, and should be intuitive for adjusters and collision estimators.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. 95% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators shall find the product easy to use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be compatible with standard corporate browsers and tablets, and should degrade gracefully on flaky mobile networks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should implement fuzzy matching in searches to accommodate for variations in how users input vehicle codes and shop names.
The system should follow corporate architecture and UI guidelines to ensure consistency with other tools and ease of deployment.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have audit trails tied to estimates, allowing regulators and internal audit to see who changed what and when.
The system should provide real-time or near-real-time updates for parts availability to ensure adjusters are offering parts that are actually available.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'
